Title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux gold images now available on Azure

Body.Content:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) bring-your-own-subscription images, also referred to as RHEL gold images, are now available in Azure with a simple, automated sign-up process.

To learn more about how to operate the BYOS for Red Hat Enterprise Linux, please follow the document.

Bring Your Own Subscription (BYOS) official announcement blog from Red Hat is here.

Learn more
